en: Sepia-tone theatrical publicity postcard showing a woman in an elegant dress and a man in a suit, both squatting and playfully pointing at each other. German text at the top references the operetta 'Der Graf von Luxemburg' and the Centraltheater. Their names, Flora Hegner and Oscar Aigner, are printed near their feet. The photographer's mark at the bottom left reads 'HERZFELD DRESDEN 1910.'
